scheme_name: Gujarat Textile Policy: Power Tariff Subsidy (Fiscal Incentives to Labour Intensive Unit)
other_conditions: Must be recognized as a Labour Intensive Unit
New industrial units are eligible; existing units undergoing expansion, diversification, or modernization are also eligible
Must provide minimum employment of 4,000 persons registered under EPF, with at least 1,000 female employees
Must submit electricity bills in the unit's name
Application must be submitted within one year from the Date of Commercial Production (DoCP)
For expansion/diversification/modernization, subsidy applies only to additional power consumption beyond the previous year’s average

Eligible activities include Garments, Apparel & Made‑ups, Technical Textiles (including Composite Unit); Weaving (with or without preparatory), Knitting, Dyeing & Processing, Texturising, Twisting, Embroidery and MMF Spinning from Polyester Staple Fiber/Viscose Staple Fiber (excluding cotton and synthetic filament yarn)
benefits_summary: Provides a power tariff subsidy of INR 1 per kWh for DISCOM or renewable power, capped at INR 15 crore per year for 5 years from the date of commercial production.
documents_required: Electricity bills in the unit's name
